data.mechanism: Active mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB right on the lysosomal surface, trapping it in the cytoplasm. Switch mTORC1 off and TFEB walks into the nucleus.
data.mechanism_beginner: Active mTORC1 tags TFEB and traps it outside the nucleus; switch mTORC1 off and TFEB moves in.
data.context: Substrate-selective. Depends on FLCN/FNIP RagC/D status, so mTORC1 can be active on S6K1 while not phosphorylating TFEB.
data.boundary: RagD specifically (more than RagC) promotes TFEB/TFE3 phosphorylation via tighter LAMTOR binding — GOL2022 shows this is paralogue-specific, not a generic Rag-dimer property.
data.note: Four independent studies - one of the best-supported output edges.
